title: Add Expense Agent consumption V2 and trial support
summary: Expense Agent adds a V2 consumption API and a 50-expense feature trial, with trial status in the billing overview and remaining free expenses in setup. Quota checks go through an internal interface so tests can inject a mock, and telemetry now logs a static message with selected metadata dimensions instead of the raw request.
key_points: V2 consumption API validates nested v1 fields and required identifiers and rejects null usage values
50-expense trial; policy-evaluation operations do not count toward trial usage
Trial status shown in billing overview and remaining free expenses in setup wizard
Saved trial classification is preserved on retries, and consumption is allowed when trial quota is available
Internal quota interface with a default production implementation and test injection
quote: Add the Expense Agent V2 consumption API and a 50-expense feature trial.
